summary: A south west London independent agency appears to lose valuation enquiries to a free builder address, spelling errors and a 2014 footer.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a banner that says This website was built on Wix.
findings.cost: A free builder address makes an estate agent look temporary to landlords and sellers.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean branded site.

findings.problem: Typos such as Mangement, Surronding and mangement appear in the page text.
findings.cost: Spelling errors in your own service names weaken trust with owners choosing an agent.
An old year suggests the agency may not be active.
findings.fix: A footer that updates by itself.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp and no reviews or sold results appear on the homepage.
findings.cost: Owners choose the agent who shows proof and answers fast.
findings.fix: Named reviews, sold examples and WhatsApp.
